About me

I am currently an Applied Scientist at Amazon Web Services. My research aims to advance trustworthy and efficient machine learning.

I develop methods to protect privacy and make learning more efficient. I also study how models fail under attack. My current research focuses on language models and AI agents.

I received my Ph.D. in Computer Science from Old Dominion University in 2022, advised by Cong Wang.
